# Found First

> Founder-led AI marketing: answer engine optimization and ChatGPT advertising.

Contact: nick@befoundfirst.ai

## Perspectives
- [Answer engine optimization services](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/answer-engine-optimization/): Found First is an AEO and GEO agency. We improve website content so buyers can understand your services, compare the evidence and contact the right team.
- [Getting recommended by ChatGPT](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/get-recommended-by-chatgpt/): Found First helps businesses improve organic ChatGPT visibility through clearer websites, accurate positioning and evidence buyers can use.
- [Google AI Overviews and AI Mode](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/google-ai-overviews/): Understand Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, their relationship to SEO, and where Found First can improve organic business visibility.
- [AEO content strategy](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/aeo-content-strategy/): Found First develops clear business content for organic AI discovery, with distinct buyer value, credible evidence and a useful next step.
- [AEO vs. SEO vs. GEO](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/aeo-vs-seo-vs-geo/): Understand the overlap between SEO, AEO and GEO, and decide which visibility problem needs attention before buying another service.
- [ChatGPT ads vs. Google Ads](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/chatgpt-ads-vs-google-ads/): Compare ChatGPT Ads with Google Search advertising around buyer intent, targeting expectations, destinations and useful business outcomes.
- [ChatGPT advertising costs](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/chatgpt-advertising-cost/): Understand ChatGPT advertising cost categories, media spend, management fees and website readiness before discussing a Found First engagement.
- [ChatGPT ads management](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/chatgpt-ads-agency/): Advertise on ChatGPT with Found First. We manage sponsored campaigns, creative, landing pages and measurement around the action you want buyers to take.
- [AI visibility audits](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/ai-visibility-audit/): An AEO and GEO audit examines how AI answers describe your business, which sources they cite, and where buyers encounter an incomplete picture.
- [Measuring AI marketing results](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/measure-ai-marketing-roi/): Found First separates AI mentions, citations, paid conversions and customer outcomes so marketing investment can be judged on meaningful evidence.
- [Choosing an AEO agency](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/choose-aeo-agency/): Compare AEO agencies by service clarity, relevant proof, website judgment and accountable people. Discuss Found First's approach on a call with Nick.
- [AEO for local businesses](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/aeo-for-local-businesses/): Found First helps local businesses improve organic AI visibility through clearer service information, website improvements and useful content.
- [AEO for multi-location brands](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/aeo-for-multi-location-brands/): Found First helps multi-location brands improve organic AI visibility while keeping local services, identities and customer paths clear.
- [AEO for professional services](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/aeo-for-professional-services/): Found First helps professional firms clarify expertise, service scope and client fit through organic AI visibility and website improvements.
- [AEO for B2B and SaaS](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/ai-marketing-for-b2b-saas/): Found First helps B2B and SaaS companies clarify product fit and earn relevant consideration through organic AI visibility and website work.
- [AEO for ecommerce brands](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/ai-marketing-for-ecommerce/): Found First helps ecommerce brands clarify product differences and buying fit through organic AI visibility, website and content improvements.
This file is a reading aid, not a requirement for AI search visibility.

## Original research
- [Research and insights](https://befoundfirst.ai/research/): Original research and selected public proof.
- [Does a HELOC always come second? Michigan’s mortgage records give an answer.](https://befoundfirst.ai/research/michigan-heloc-lien-position/): Of 46,741 qualifying Michigan home equity lines originated in 2025, 12,539 were recorded in first lien position. See the counts by loan purpose.
- [How often do West Michigan thunderstorm wind reports mention trees?](https://befoundfirst.ai/research/west-michigan-storm-tree-reports/): In Kent, Ionia and Montcalm counties, 48 of 64 NOAA thunderstorm wind event reports mentioned a tree or trees during 2021 through 2025.
- [Airport hotel shuttle hours study](https://befoundfirst.ai/research/airport-hotel-shuttle-hours/): First-party evidence from 12 hotels across three airports.
- [Rooter-Man Austin study](https://befoundfirst.ai/research/rooter-man-austin/): Selected dated baseline findings.
- [Being named is not enough](https://befoundfirst.ai/research/mentions-sources-recommendations/): The meaning behind a mention.
